title: Fix Strategy — agent strategy input
description: The judgement half of a fix plan. Written by the Fix Strategist agent to .github/.pipeline-context/fix-strategy/<issue_id>.strategy.json after reading the context briefing and the matched CWE catalog entry in full, then consumed by scripts/render-fix-plan.js. This is strategy only — no diff, no applied code. Illustrative code, if included, must not be presented as a patch; that is the Fixer agent's job.

issue_id.description: Must match the id in the context bundle, e.g. ISSUE-001.

cwe.description: The single CWE this plan remediates, e.g. CWE-943. Pick the one that best names the root cause, not every CWE loosely related to the symptom.

confidence.description: High only when the catalog pattern applies cleanly to the defect site as described in the root cause report.

plain_summary.description: One sentence a non-engineer would understand: what the fix changes and why it closes the hole.

approach.description: 2-5 sentences: the remediation strategy adapted from the catalog entry's canonical_approach to this specific defect site, and why it addresses the root cause rather than the symptom.

cwe.description: The CWE id looked up in the catalog, e.g. CWE-943.

title.description: The catalog entry's title. Set to null only when the detected CWE has no catalog entry (a catalog gap) — explain the gap in open_questions rather than inventing a pattern.

alternatives_considered.description: Other remediation approaches considered and why they were rejected in favour of this one (e.g. why input blacklisting was rejected in favour of parameterised queries).

affected_files.description: Per-file planned change. No diffs here — describe the change in prose; the Fixer writes the actual patch.

planned_change.description: What must change in this file and why, specific enough for the Fixer to act on without re-deriving the strategy.

illustrative_sketch.description: Optional. A short Java snippet illustrating the target shape of the fix. Must be clearly illustrative — the Fixer may adapt it to match exact surrounding style, imports and error handling; it is not an applied patch.

risk_notes.description: What the Fixer and a reviewer should watch for: behavioural changes, migration needs, performance implications, backward compatibility.

verification_plan.description: Concrete, checkable steps that prove the fix works — what to compile/test, and how to confirm the original exploit/symptom from the issue no longer reproduces. The Fixer's verification must address these.

open_questions.description: Anything the context bundle could not settle, including catalog gaps. Use this instead of guessing.

dependency_upgrade.description: Required only when cwe is CWE-1104 (or another dependency-version CWE added later). Turns 'bump the version' into machine-checkable facts that 04c-dependency-upgrader's verification script checks deterministically, instead of relying on prose alone.

minimum_fixed_version.description: The lowest version that remediates the advisory, per its own affected/fixed range — not necessarily 'latest'.

cve.description: The CVE id, if one exists, e.g. CVE-2025-31672.

advisory_url.description: Link to the advisory used to determine minimum_fixed_version.
